sketches.mechanism: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance that can never be duplicated or reinstantiated.
sketches.resonance: Some things exist only once; the language enforces that this moment cannot be repeated or copied.

sketches.mechanism: A `void` function that takes `void` — it accepts nothing and returns nothing, yet the body still executes.
sketches.resonance: Even when nothing is given and nothing is returned, something still happens inside.

sketches.mechanism: The `finally` block always executes, regardless of whether an exception was thrown or caught — even after a `return`.
sketches.resonance: No matter what happens — success, failure, or escape — some things you carry with you always.
